author: Krono II
title: Hypothesis Test: Triple-Step Recurrence
abstract: This experiment tests the hypothesis that increasing the depth of recurrent computation from two steps to three will improve planning capabilities. It builds directly on the SOTA architecture (ID 219), modifying only the number of ConvLSTM steps. All other components (BottleneckBlock, dilated CNN, hyperparameters) are held constant to isolate the impact of deeper recurrence.
